model.name: R19.2.A: Room name shows a pencil edit icon that opens the room config/scenario editor on click.
model.description: The room name displayed in-room MUST carry a pencil edit icon (same edit affordance as the file browser). Clicking the pencil (or the room name itself per R19.2) opens the room config/scenario editor for the room unit. Refines R19.2 with (1) gap evidence that as of T-room-ui v0.5.129 the click-to-edit room editor is not implemented, and (2) a visual-affordance addendum so the user sees that the name is editable.
model.tronQuote: > TRON (gap): "the app has no room config/scenario editor yet clicking on the room name in the room." + ADDENDUM: "add a pencil like in the browser to see it opens an editor."
model.refinementOfNote: Refines R19.2 (click-to-edit room editor). Two atomic constraints folded into one refinement: (a) a pencil edit icon next to the room name as visible editability affordance, matching the file browser convention; (b) clicking the pencil OR the name opens the room config/scenario editor. PO directive 2026-06-10 originally referenced R19.1, req-eng re-routed to R19.2 because R19.2 owns the click-to-edit semantic while R19.1 is the room-as-scenario-unit data shape.
